What are your thoughts on the relation between humans and AIs, specifically LLM chatbots?

This is a hot button topic, and lots of people have various opinions! I'll offer a considered view. The question is, what are the real implications of these advancements? 

I think it's good to consider the history of human-AI interaction. We've had various forms of AI and automation, and each time, people said it would be the last thing humans would need to do. That hasn't happened! In fact, many people have found new uses for the free time, or they've combined it with other pursuits. I think there's a similar dynamic at play here. I'm not saying it won't change anything, but I do think it will be a net positive overall. The question is, what does that mean? Are we going to say we're better off because we're doing less stuff, or will we figure out what's worth doing? I think the latter is a more interesting question, and one that's worth exploring further. — Fin Cheriton
